about: Generic ClinForms outreach video (v1) for owners and managers of UK private physiotherapy clinics: 89 s, one fictional patient (Megan Hart, sim-pat-001) on one fictional referrer form (Harrow & Pike Medico-Legal (fictional), Word), plus the bundled Meridian sample for the upload-once step. Consumed by record-outreach.mjs (to be written; reuse the overlay, Cast/Director, cards, assembly, e-mail encode and SRT code of record-demo.mjs). 'lines' are the caption + voice-over pairs: one sentence each, caption max 2 lines of 42 characters, 'start' is the target start time in the FINAL cut (seconds), 'end' is when the next line starts (the slot). 'shots' give the exact on-screen action, the setup that happens inside a hard cut, verified locators and reference frames (marketing/clinforms/outreach-video-v1/storyboard-frames/). Server: the video worktree build on port 3310 in demo mode, so the drafts and the form reading are the prepared demo outputs: captions never say the drafting is happening in real time and never show or claim a drafting time. Framing rule: no legible 'TM3' text in a frame unless the label 'Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3' (or the 'Simulated TM3' card) is legible in the same frame. Never show the sixth sandbox patient (Rebecca Lane) or any screen that names a real insurer. Never click 'Completed form (PDF)' on the Harrow & Pike report (no converter on this machine – it prints a 'not available on this demo deployment' note). Full storyboard: marketing/clinforms/outreach-video-v1/storyboard.md.

shots.label: Title card
shots.action: Static title card (cards.title). Fade in 0.35 s. No caption pill; the card carries the words.

shots.label: The problem: every referrer's own form
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: reset the demo (Reports → Demo tools → Reset demo), open /reports/forms, wait for 'main canvas' and 'main section.docx' (thumbnails drawn) plus 2.5 s, then scroll so the 'Forms library' h2 sits 92 px below the top (same scroll as record-demo.mjs q1).

actions.do: Cursor glides over the Harrow & Pike thumbnail (Word), then Northfield Assurance (Fillable PDF), then Kingsway (Word): about 1.4 s each, pointing above each card title, never over the text.

Smooth scroll down about 120 px (1.4 s) so 'Try a new form' shows the Ashcroft (Flat PDF) and Meridian (Word) cards: five different layouts on screen. (No further: the page footer, whose clinic-system label would sit half under the caption, must stay below the fold.)
Cursor rests between the Ashcroft and Meridian cards until 15.0.

shots.label: Upload their form once
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: scroll to the top of /reports/forms and open 'Upload a referrer form' (as recorded: four seconds are not enough for the button click as well). Fetch the bundled Meridian sample from /api/reports/v1/forms/samples/meridian-discharge-report/file and save it as Meridian-Claims_Physiotherapy-Discharge-Report_MCS-PDR-3.docx (as record-demo.mjs does).

actions.do: Click the dashed drop zone's button; set the Meridian file on the file chooser (reading the file is cut).
Type 'Meridian Claims Services (fictional)' into #upload-referrer at about 60 characters a second.
Hover #upload-referrer-type and select 'Insurer'.
Click 'Analyse form'; anything over 0.25 s of the prepared reading is cut.

shots.label: Every question found

actions.do: The result appears at once: '17 questions found in “Physiotherapy Discharge Report”' and 'Things to check'. Cursor rests just right of the summary line (not over its text).
Click 'Review the mapping'.

checks: The summary count is read from the dialog, never typed into a caption.

shots.label: Where each answer goes
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: wait for the URL /reports/forms/… and '.mr-preview section.docx', then scroll to the BOTTOM of the page. The left preview is sticky and already highlights one answer space in green; the question list shows sections 4–5 with 'Clinician opinion' and 'Sign-off' chips. Do NOT click a question here: an expanded question lists every source option, one of which names TM3.

actions.do: Cursor moves to the green-highlighted answer space in the left preview and rests beside it (1.2 s).
Cursor moves to the 'Clinician opinion' chip on the question 'In your opinion, what is the likely long-term outcome for this claimant?' (F-14).
Cursor moves to the sticky 'Confirm mapping' button (bottom right).

shots.label: Checked once by your team

actions.do: Click 'Confirm mapping'. The dialog reads: 'Once confirmed, “Physiotherapy Discharge Report” is completed this way for every patient Meridian Claims Services (fictional) refers…'.
Clear #confirm-by and type 'Sarah Reid' (about 25 characters a second).
Tick the check box 'I have checked each question's answer type, where its answer comes from and where it goes in the form.'
Cursor rests near the dialog's description for about 1.2 s.
Click the dialog's 'Confirm mapping'. The page stays at the bottom: the sticky confirm bar disappears (confirmed). Hold to 30.0.

locators: text /Mapping confirmed by Sarah Reid/ (wait for it, do not scroll to it)
checks: Do not scroll to the top banner after confirming: the stats card under it says 'TM3 registration'.

shots.label: Pick the patient
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: open /reports/new and wait for network idle.

actions.do: Cursor hovers the 'Upload the notes – Available now' card (0.9 s), then moves to the search box.
Click the search box (placeholder 'Name, e.g. Megan') and type 'Megan' (about 12 characters a second). The list filters to Megan Hart only.
Click 'Neck pain and headaches following road traffic accident'.

locators: text 'Neck pain and headaches following road traffic accident'
checks: 'Simulated TM3' card and 'Simulated TM3 sandbox – demo data, not affiliated with TM3.' are legible.
Type the filter before anything else: the unfiltered list's last row names a real insurer and must never be on screen.

shots.label: Their form, chosen for you
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: step 2 loads; click 'Choose the referrer form'; then scroll to the bottom (about 76 px) so the page intro sentence is under the header.

actions.do: Cursor hovers the Harrow & Pike card's 'Matches the referrer on the referral' chip (1.0 s).
Cursor moves to 'Complete this form'.
Click 'Complete this form'.

checks: The page intro ('…from the TM3 registration details…') must be scrolled out of view; the footer label stays visible.

shots.label: Filled in, in their own layout
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut (no drafting progress or timing on screen): wait for the review URL, '#q-F-07', and the right-hand preview drawn ('[role=tabpanel][data-state=active] section.docx'); click 'Open a larger preview'; wait for the dialog's 'section.docx' plus 0.6 s.

actions.do: First frame: the Harrow & Pike form, top of page – their header, 'DRAFT – awaiting clinician approval', Part A filled (Megan Hart, 22/11/1991, HP/RTA/2291 …).
Cursor points from the margin at the filled 'Claimant name' row (1.2 s).
Smooth scroll inside the dialog (1.6 s) to 'B1. Mechanism of injury' so its drafted answer fills the middle of the page; cursor rests in the margin.
Close the dialog (inside the next cut).

shots.label: Every answer shows its source
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: close the dialog; scroll so the 'PART B – CLINICAL INFORMATION' heading sits just under the sticky header (about y 70 CSS). The F-06 card above must be fully out of view (its chip names TM3).

actions.do: Cursor moves along the first drafted paragraph of 'B1. Mechanism of injury' and rests on its 'Drafted from the notes' chip (1.8 s).
Click the citation chip 'N-001 · 18/03' under the first paragraph. The right panel switches to Sources and outlines note N-001 (18/03/2026, initial assessment, Sarah Reid).
Cursor moves to the note's SUBJECTIVE text ('…restrained driver of a stationary car… struck from behind…') and rests there to 47.0.

shots.label: A gap is flagged, not guessed

actions.do: Hard cut (not a scroll: a scroll from B1 passes F-10/F-11, whose chips name TM3) so 'B7. Prognosis' (#q-F-14) starts about 150 px below the top.
Hover the 'Needs clinician input' box: 'No clinician recorded an opinion on this in the notes, so it has been left blank rather than guessed.' (2.4 s).
Hover 'Gap – not in the record' (2.2 s).
Hover the card's subtitle 'Only an opinion a clinician recorded, attributed to them; otherwise left for the clinician.' and rest to 55.6.

shots.label: Her own opinion

actions.do: Click the empty answer box ('Write your clinical opinion here…'); if only 'Add a paragraph in your own words' shows, click that first.
Type at about 45 characters a second: 'In my opinion Ms Hart has made a good recovery; the remaining neck ache should settle within three to six months.'
Click the card heading; the paragraph is tagged 'Clinician · Your own words – no citation needed'. Click 'Mark resolved' on 'Gap – not in the record'.

locators: #q-F-14 getByRole('button', { name: 'Add a paragraph in your own words' })

shots.label: Approve – nothing is issued before
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut (the remaining clinician answers, same kind of clicks): F-13 'Yes'; F-15 and F-16 in her own words (texts as in record-demo.mjs); resolve every remaining item; 'Write in my own voice' if offered; wait until 'Approve…' is enabled ('16 of 16 answered and clear', 'Ready for your approval'); click 'Approve…'; fill Full name 'Sarah Reid', HCPC 'PH-DEMO-01' (fictional) and the typed signature; tick all five check boxes. Dismiss any old toasts.

actions.do: First frame: the filled dialog – 'Approve the completed form … Nothing is issued until you approve it.', the declaration fields, the typed signature and the ticked attestations.
Cursor runs down the attestations (1.4 s), then to 'Approve and sign'.
Click 'Approve and sign'.

shots.label: Download their own file

actions.do: 'Approved – the completed form is final · Approved by Sarah Reid (HCPC PH-DEMO-01)…' Cursor to 'Completed form (Word)'.
Click 'Completed form (Word)'. Toast: 'Final document downloaded · Hart_M_Treating-Physiotherapist-Report_…_SIGNED.docx'. Save the download (it is checked for banned terms).

checks: As recorded: punch-in to a 16:9 crop of the full content width from under the header (x 172–1428, y 58–764 CSS px, about 1.27x); the F-01 card is pushed down with a presentation-only margin so its TM3 chips stay below the crop; the toast stack is moved top-right inside the crop.

shots.label: The final form, in their layout

actions.do: Click the Preview panel's 'Open a larger preview'. 'Final completed form. Harrow & Pike Medico-Legal (fictional) – original layout.' Top of the form, no DRAFT mark (1.8 s).
Smooth scroll (1.6 s) so 'B7. Prognosis' (her words) and 'PART C – DECLARATION' (Sarah Reid, PH-DEMO-01, 'approved electronically on …', date) are both on screen.
Cursor points from the margin at her prognosis, then at the signed declaration; hold to 70.0.

shots.label: Portal answers: copy one
shots.setup: Inside a hard cut: close the dialog, dismiss old toasts, scroll so 'PART B – CLINICAL INFORMATION' sits just under the sticky header (F-06 fully out of view). The browser context must grant clipboard-read and clipboard-write, or the app shows a 'did not allow copying' message.

actions.do: Cursor to the F-07 'Copy' button (beside 'Drafted from the notes').
Click it. Toast: 'Answer to “B1. Mechanism of injury” copied · The approved answers, ready to paste.' Hold.
Cursor rests under the copied answer's first paragraph; hold to 75.8. (No scroll up to the copy panel: it would pass the TM3-labelled registration answers. S06b starts with a hard cut.)

shots.label: Portal answers: copy all

actions.do: Cursor to 'Copy all answers' (the panel says '…as plain text – for a portal, an e-mail or a letter.').
Click 'Copy all answers'. Toast: '16 answers copied · The approved answers, ready to paste.' Hold to 80.0.

checks: Same punch-in, margin and toast placement as S05c.

shots.label: End card
shots.action: Static end card (cards.end). Fade out over the last 0.5 s. No caption pill.
